english.row_tail: The reports concerning his cistern on the Day of Standing are numerous, which we have mentioned in the Book of Remembrance, and that upon its four corners are his four Caliphs, may God be pleased with them. Whoever despises one of them, the other will not give him to drink, and we mentioned there those driven away from it. Whosoever desires to understand that should contemplate it there.
